An evolving record of work, thoughts and questions as I work through the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge.
I am joining the challenge as part of a communal effort to learn and writing this to clarify my own thoughts[^writing-to-learn] and share useful information I find along the way.
I will do my best to avoid jargon and target the material to as wide an audience as possible.
Disclaimer I: I am neither a biologist, nor a bioinformatician, nor a virtual cell expert, so I am learning much of this material on the fly.
Disclaimer II: I am a physicist, so some of the material may be quite mathy.
I hope you enjoy the read.

[^writing-to-learn]: William Zinsser, [*Writing to Learn*](https://www.harpercollins.com/products/writing-to-learn-william-zinsser) (1988), makes the case that writing about a subject is one of the best ways to understand it.
